activity.notes: Hunyadi János was elected governor (kormányzó) of Hungary in 1446 during the minority of Ladislaus V and resigned the governorship at the beginning of 1453. ATLAS normalizes this minority-government office to the existing Regent role while preserving the historically specific governor title in notes; his later captain-general command and earlier Transylvanian voivodeship are not duplicated here.

sources.title: Hunyadi János kormányzósága — Magyar Katolikus Lexikon
sources.citation_text: The Hungarian Catholic Lexicon dates Hunyadi János's governorship of Hungary from June 1446 to January 1453 and describes the authority delegated to him during Ladislaus V's minority.

sources.title: Pannonian Renaissance — John Hunyadi, Matthias Hunyadi, Beatrix
sources.citation_text: The Hungarian Electronic Library biography records Hunyadi's election as governor in June 1446, his resignation in early 1453, and subsequent office as captain-in-chief.
